youtube_description:
Subscribe:  https://www.youtube.com/channel/UC51g2r_bWOQq-7Y-VwU9sYA?sub_confirmation=1

In this video, I discuss PromptBase, an online marketplace where users can buy and sell AI prompts. The speaker is on the site and has clicked on the marketplace to view the different items that are available for purchase. The items are sorted by price as well as by type - i.e. Midjourney, ChatGPT, stable diffusion, and prompt base. 

The speaker has bought one prompt for website mockups and shares that it gives a prompt and instructions. However, the speaker feels that the prompt isn't worth the money as the information can be found for free online. The speaker shows an example of searching for a prompt on the site and demonstrates how the information can be found for free without purchasing it. 

In conclusion, the speaker thinks that the marketplace is not worth the money, but encourages others to try it out and share their thoughts in the comments.
